Katariya Steel has achieved a renowned name as a supplier, exporter, and manufacturer of 
IS 1239 ERW Pipe & Tube
 because of a team of skilled specialists and a well-resourced setup facility. Our company's strong export percentage reflects its forward-thinking nature.
IS 1239 ERW Pipe & Tube is made up of mild steel material. It is composed of 0.20 percent carbon, 1.30 percent manganese, and 0.040 percent sulfur and phosphorus. These pipes are designed to withstand high pressures and temperatures in a range of environments. They have a minimum tensile strength of 48 Ksi (min), yield strength of 28.3 Ksi (min), and can be easily stretched by 25.4 percent. These are made of totally deoxidized stainless steel. These pipes are manufactured without the use of welds or seams. They are exceptionally sturdy, long-lasting, and simple to maintain. Low and high frequencies are not a problem for these pipes and tubes and are also affordable and efficient. These may be made using either a cold or hot rolling technique. It may be heat treated in several ways, including normalizing, quenching, martempering, and quenched and tempered.

They are a popular choice for boilers, food processing, and other applications. These are utilized in extremely dangerous and harsh conditions. As a result, they are extensively utilized in heat exchangers, oil, gas, and petroleum piping systems, as well as tube fluid pipelines, condensers, and so on.
